findings.finding: Standard JSON Schema cannot compare target.headCommitSha, verification.verifiedCommitSha and ciRuns[].commitSha across separate objects. The proposal adds src/hsmart_platform/uede_contracts.py to enforce exact equality and require a successful CI run on the same HEAD.
findings.disposition: Any receipt consumer must run JSON Schema validation and the semantic validator together. An adapter that calls only the schema validator is not acceptable for PASS receipts.

findings.finding: The PRE snapshot contract is defined, but no canonical PRE Git source, supported shared API/runtime or live read-only adapter has been verified in this implementation.
findings.disposition: Keep the adapter unimplemented or explicitly NOT_CONFIGURED until PRE source, rights, API transport and pagination behavior are confirmed. Do not convert Notion connector access into a claim of deployed PRE API.

findings.finding: HSO catalog entries are not equivalent to host-enabled, rights-cleared and runtime-tested capabilities. Generic skill invocation remains NOT_CONFIGURED in the current HSO audit.
findings.disposition: Use the descriptor for read-only discovery. Keep capabilities BLOCKED or NOT_ASSESSED until source, license, parity, contract test, host activation and real invocation evidence all pass.
